name: NEWMAC Cross Country Championships
headline: NEWMAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: MIT swept the team titles. The MIT women scored 19 points to Coast Guard’s 56 and Smith’s 84, and MIT’s Liv Girand won the 6K in 22:17.6. The MIT men won with 25 points ahead of WPI (59) and Babson (66); WPI’s Everett Mosher won the 8K in 24:45.1, with Babson’s Nick Yacoub second in 24:49.2.
